fix(OP-36): preserve durable paper jobs and activation epochs

Selectively adapted 839cc044bc861746af33c4b6f4ebcc6ad0d96049. Preserve native V3 isolation, add durable job leases and replay identity, activation epochs, ledger idempotency and bootstrap EOF diagnostics. RC5 pins and legacy worker constructor are deliberately excluded. 88 paper/job/registry/ledger regression tests pass on Python 3.13; full sandbox acceptance remains separate.

    artifact: Mapping[str, object], producer_commits: Mapping[str, str]

    generated = artifact.get("generated_artifact")

    if not isinstance(generated, Mapping) or not isinstance(bundle, Mapping):
        raise AdmitError(
            "generated artifact and consumer bundle are required",
